controls.name: Account Management
controls.objective: Manage information system accounts including identifying account types and approving access.

required_signals: operator_approval_id is set for privileged spawn

controls.name: Access Enforcement
controls.objective: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

controls.name: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.objective: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information.

required_signals: no entry exceeds policy classification envelope
no entry uses caveat outside allowlist

controls.name: Least Privilege
controls.objective: Employ the principle of least privilege.

required_signals: denies present in window prove default-deny posture

controls.name: Event Logging
controls.objective: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging.

required_signals: all action types observed in coverage period

controls.name: Content of Audit Records
controls.objective: Audit records contain information that establishes what type of event occurred, when, where, source, outcome, and identity.

required_signals: all required LedgerEntry fields present per schema

controls.name: Protection of Audit Information
controls.objective: Protect audit records and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, deletion.

required_signals: every segment signature verifies against pinned Enterprise pubkey

controls.name: Non-Repudiation
controls.objective: Protect against an individual falsely denying having performed an action.

required_signals: agent identity bound to each entry

controls.name: Audit Record Generation
controls.objective: Provide audit record generation capability for the events defined in AU-2.

controls.name: Baseline Configuration
controls.objective: Develop, document, and maintain a baseline configuration.

required_signals: current policy bundle signed and pinned

controls.name: Configuration Change Control
controls.objective: Determine and document changes to the system.

required_signals: bundle rotations logged with before/after SHA-384

controls.name: Least Functionality
controls.objective: Configure the system to provide only essential capabilities.

controls.name: Identification and Authentication (Org. Users)
controls.objective: Uniquely identify and authenticate users.

controls.name: Device Identification and Authentication
controls.objective: Uniquely identify devices before establishing connection.

controls.name: Service Identification and Authentication
controls.objective: Identify and authenticate services.

required_signals: every agent has hardware-backed P-384 identity

controls.name: Incident Handling
controls.objective: Implement an incident handling capability.

controls.name: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.objective: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities.

controls.name: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.objective: Require developer to perform testing and evaluation.

controls.name: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.objective: Protect confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.name: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.objective: Establish and manage cryptographic keys.

controls.name: Cryptographic Protection
controls.objective: Implement cryptographic mechanisms.

controls.name: System Monitoring
controls.objective: Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

controls.name: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.objective: Employ integrity verification tools.
